confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Thai price levels and Ayutthaya's position as a day-trip and weekend destination near Bangkok; no live menus or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is the least certain group, especially the 3-star anchor, which assumes Thai VAT and service charges are included. July is green-season, so accommodation is shaded slightly below peak-season rates. Cocktail and wine anchors use the usual Thai restaurant markup over beer, since direct local knowledge is limited. The FX observation is the most recent RBA figure found in search (15 Oct 2026); the 16 Oct fix was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional Thai pricing for provincial heritage towns and day-trip destinations near Bangkok (such as Kanchanaburi and Lopburi), adjusted for Ayutthaya's tourist accommodation supply and restaurant mix.
